THE DESTINATION

About Kanatal & Tehri Lake

Kanatal is a quiet hill town in the Tehri Garhwal region of Uttarakhand, known for its pine and deodar forests, cool mountain air, and easy access to some of the region's best-loved sights. It's the perfect short getaway from Delhi — close enough for a weekend, but far enough to feel like a real escape into the mountains.

From Kanatal, visit the sacred Surkanda Devi Temple and Dhanaulti Eco Park, then head to Tehri Lake — one of Asia's largest man-made lakes — for a day of jet skiing, banana rides, and speed boating, with a stop for the Ganga Aarti in Rishikesh on the way back to Delhi.

WHAT AWAITS YOU

Major Trip Highlights

Scenic getaway to Kanatal — pine forests and cool mountain air.

Adventure activities — Zip Line, Burma Bridge, and Sky Cycling.

Visit the sacred Surkanda Devi Temple — and Dhanaulti Eco Park.

Water sports at Tehri Lake — jet skiing, banana ride, speed boat.

Ganga Aarti stop at Rishikesh — on the way back to Delhi.

Bonfire and light music — at the Kanatal camp-site.

Comfortable AC Bus / Traveller — Delhi to Delhi.

Trip Coordinator & 24x7 support — throughout the trip.

DAY BY DAY

Your Itinerary

  • Assembly: Board the Bus/Traveller from Vaishali Metro Station, Delhi.
  • Reporting: Reporting time 10:30 PM.
  • Travel: Overnight journey to Kanatal.
  • Arrival: Reach Kanatal and have breakfast.
  • Check-In: Check in to the rooms, get freshened up for adventure activities.
  • Sightseeing: Visit Dhanaulti Eco Park and Surkanda Devi Mandir.
  • Evening: Back to the property, enjoy evening snacks and tea.
  • Night: Enjoy dinner at night with bonfire and light music.
  • Morning: Wake up early and enjoy the beautiful morning view of Kanatal, refresh & have breakfast.
  • Tehri Lake: Drive to Tehri Lake (around 1 hour) for adventure activities.
  • Water Sports: Enjoy jet skiing, banana ride, jet attack, speed boat and more on direct payment basis.
  • Rishikesh: Depart for Rishikesh for Ganga Aarti (depending on time) and local sightseeing.
  • Arrival: Reach Delhi by early morning.
WHAT YOU PAY FOR

Inclusions & Exclusions

Included in your package

  • Travel by AC & comfortable Bus / Traveller
  • 1 night stay at Kanatal camp-site

Not included in your package

  • 5% GST

  • Medical expenses (apart from first aid) and insurance of any kind
  • Tips, laundry, liquors, wines, mineral water, telephone charges, camera fee
  • Cost escalation due to landslide, road closure, or natural calamity
